english.title: Use a goods vehicle to carry goods for hire / reward on a road when the operators licence was restricted

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Goods Vehicle Licensing of Operators Act 1995

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for carrying goods for hire or reward on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the licence was restricted
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(6) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) for the carriage of **(..SPECIFY GOODS..) for hire or reward.

The operator's licence was restricted to use of the goods vehicle on a road for the carriage of goods for or in connection with the trade or business carried on by the holder of the licence.
